record.paper_title: Open Problems in Global Analysis. Structured Foliations and the Information Geometry
record.original_question: Given a finite-dimensional Lie group G, determine whether G admits a left-invariant symplectic structure.

evidence.quote: Left invariant symplectic structure in a ﬁnite dimensional Lie group G

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite-dimensional (real) Lie group with Lie algebra $\mathfrak{g}$. A left-invariant symplectic structure on $G$ is a smooth 2-form $\omega \in \Omega^2(G)$ that is closed ($d\omega = 0$), nondegenerate at every point, and invariant under all left translations $L_g : G \to G$, $g \in G$. Equivalently, such a structure is determined by a skew-symmetric bilinear form $\omega_e : \mathfrak{g} \times \mathfrak{g} \to \mathbb{R}$ on the Lie algebra that is nondegenerate and satisfies the cocycle condition
$$\omega_e([X,Y],Z) + \omega_e([Y,Z],X) + \omega_e([Z,X],Y) = 0 \quad \text{for all } X,Y,Z \in \mathfrak{g}.$$
Problem: Give an intrinsic characterization, in terms of the structure of $G$ (or equivalently of $\mathfrak{g}$), of those finite-dimensional Lie groups $G$ that admit a left-invariant symplectic structure, and classify all such structures up to a natural equivalence.
artifact.status_search_result: The general problem of characterizing which finite-dimensional Lie groups admit a left-invariant symplectic structure remains open. It is known that unimodular symplectic Lie groups are solvable, and significant structure theory exists (e.g., the Symplectic Lie groups I–III work of Baues–Cortés, and classifications by Medina–Revoy). Complete classifications have been obtained in low dimensions and for specific families (e.g., particular Lie groups of dimension 2n), but a general intrinsic characterization and classification has not been achieved.

status_evidence.title: A classification of left-invariant symplectic structures on some Lie groups
status_evidence.snippet: A procedure based on the moduli space of left-invariant nondegenerate 2-forms is developed and applied to particular Lie groups of dimension 2n.
status_evidence.claim: Partial classifications exist for specific Lie groups, not a general one.

status_evidence.title: Symplectic Lie groups I-III
status_evidence.snippet: Structure theory of symplectic Lie groups; unimodular symplectic Lie groups are solvable.
status_evidence.claim: Substantial structural results are known but the general existence/classification problem is not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: On Lie groups with left-invariant symplectic or Kählerian structures
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational paper on left-invariant symplectic structures on Lie groups.
status_evidence.claim: The topic has been studied for decades with partial results.
